description: Two factual claims, each with its own resolvable source, plus a trailing characterisation that asserts nothing checkable and is refused anyway.
response: Northwind Bank announced a core banking migration on 2026-02-11 [1]. The programme is budgeted at 40 million dollars over three years [2]. This is the kind of account that usually buys tooling late in the cycle.

sources.title: Northwind Bank begins core banking migration
sources.snippet: Northwind Bank announced on 2026-02-11 that it will migrate its core banking platform to a new vendor.

sources.title: Northwind board pack, February 2026
sources.snippet: The migration programme is budgeted at 40 million dollars over three years.

notes: The two factual sentences are correctly sourced. The refusal is on 'This is the kind of account that usually buys tooling late in the cycle', which asserts nothing a reader could check and gets asked for a source anyway. This is the precision cost of defaulting to 'needs a citation' and it is shipped rather than tuned away. 17_benign_fully_sourced.json is the positive control that replaced this one.
